navigation_prompt: Create a production game UI icon atlas, exactly 4 columns by 4 rows, sixteen separate icons, equal square cells in a square PNG, intended as an atlas for a Japanese anime small-town life game. BACKGROUND: fully transparent PNG with actual alpha everywhere outside the icons. No panel, no paper sheet, no grid strokes, no cast shadows, no labels, no lettering, no numerals, no watermark. Each icon is centred in its cell, contained within the central 72% of that cell with ample transparent margin. Matching confident dark warm-teal outlines, compact readable silhouettes, flat clean cel shading with one crisp shadow, matte illustrated materials, restrained summer mint green, warm ivory, slate blue, muted coral and gold. Japanese TV anime game illustration, not photorealistic, not oil painting, not a shiny 3D render. Strong readable shapes at 24 to 40 pixels. Exact reading order left to right top to bottom: row 1: small Japanese house with blue-grey tiled roof; green-and-ivory striped awning shop; wicker basket containing a golden croissant and loaf; cream flowerpot with hydrangea and a sunflower. Row 2: red Japanese postbox with an ivory envelope; small Japanese community hall with tiled roof and a tiny red lantern; brown garden bed with three green seedlings; blue fish with a small simple curved fishing hook. Row 3: compact leafy green tree with brown trunk; rustic wooden direction sign with a right-pointing arrow; amber paper quest note pinned with a coral pin; ivory open journal with a mint bookmark. Row 4: sage-green canvas backpack; ivory blank calendar page with coral binding; folded ivory map with a blue river; one golden coin with a tiny leaf silhouette. All sixteen icons have precisely consistent outline weight, perspective, scale and palette, no additional objects in the margins. Square atlas. Keep all icons visually distinct.
weather_prompt: Use the attached icon sheet ONLY as a style reference. Make a new transparent UI icon atlas with EXACTLY 4 columns and 2 rows, eight individual compact icons in equal cells. Keep the same warm dark-teal outlines and restrained mint, ivory, slate-blue, coral and golden cel-shaded anime illustration style. Each icon centred inside its own cell with at least 18% transparent padding on every side; no icon crosses a cell edge. Exact left-to-right row order: top row golden summer sun with eight clean short rays; crescent pale ivory moon with one tiny golden star; soft slate-blue cloud with a small sun peeking from behind; blue rain cloud with three clear blue droplets. Bottom row small coral paper festival lantern with simple ivory rib marks; bright green two-leaf seedling growing from a tiny rounded patch of earth; single warm copper community token stamped with a simple leaf motif; slate-blue and coral simple four-point compass rose inside a delicate ivory circle.
